question: To whom must the sacred teaching never be given under any circumstance?
premises: A reviler of Shiva is named
A slanderer in relation to Kula Bhairava is named
The teaching is explicitly withheld from them
inference: The teaching must not be given to those who revile Shiva or slander Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of kulabhairave to nindake is compressed.
plain_english: O Goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders Kula Bhairava.
